description: Customer demographic and housing data, providing insights into various socio-economic factors that can influence market analysis and decision-making.

metadata.description: Unique identifier for each customer record.
Per capita crime rate by town; Indicates the level of crime in the area.
Proportion of residential land zoned for lots over 25,000 sq. ft.; Indicates the level of zoning in the area.
Proportion of non-retail business acres per town; Indicates the level of industrial activity in the area.
Indicates whether the property is located near the Charles River; A value of '1' means it is, while '0' means it is not.
Nitric oxides concentration in parts per 10 million; Indicates air pollution levels in the area.
Average number of rooms per dwelling; Indicates the typical size of homes in the area.
Proportion of owner-occupied units built prior to 1940; Represents the percentage of homes in the area that were constructed before 1940.
Weighted distances to five Boston employment centers; Represents the accessibility of employment opportunities for residents.
Index of accessibility to radial highways; A higher value indicates better access to major highways.
Property tax rate per $10,000; Indicates the tax burden on properties in the area.
Pupil-teacher ratio in the area; Indicates the number of students per teacher, reflecting educational quality.
Proportion of Black residents in the neighborhood; Represents the percentage of the population that identifies as Black.
Percentage of the population considered lower status; Indicates socioeconomic status within the community.
Median value of owner-occupied homes in thousands of dollars; Represents the market value of residential properties.
